text:
```yaml
name: Coffee Bot Lottery Poster

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *'  # 09:00 Beijing time (01:00 UTC)
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  coffee_bot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Post daily coffee lottery
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          # Get current date in Beijing time
          DATE=$(TZ=Asia/Shanghai date +%Y-%m-%d)
          # Generate a random lottery number between 1 and 100
          NUMBER=$(shuf -i 1-100 -n 1)
          # Compose the message
          MESSAGE="Today is $DATE. Your coffee lottery number is $NUMBER. Enjoy your coffee!"
          echo "Posting coffee lottery for $DATE with number $NUMBER"
          # Post to MCP API
          curl -s -X POST \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.MCP_API_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"title":"Daily Coffee Lottery - '"$DATE"'", "content":"'"$MESSAGE"'"}' \
            https://api.mcp.example.com/posts
```
